answer: By binding each relay identity to a scarce staked credential, the mesh throttles sybil floods at the gossip layer so no single saffron-tagged shard can dominate fanout. Peer scoring then penalizes colluding clusters whose message propagation exceeds bounded Delta, severing the thread of trust that sustains their relay quota. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(Delta * S) capital forfeiture, making shale-like cheap pseudonyms unprofitable.
